name.title: Name
name.description: Name for this Homebridge platform instance.

email.title: hOn Email
email.description: Email address used to sign in to the hOn app.

password.title: hOn Password
password.description: Password used to sign in to the hOn app.

accessoryName.title: Accessory Name
accessoryName.description: Name shown for the wine cooler accessory in HomeKit.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Status Poll Interval Seconds
pollIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum 60 seconds. Write commands are sent immediately; this only controls status refresh polling.

autoStartBridge.title: Auto-start Python Bridge
autoStartBridge.description: Start the bundled Python pyhOn bridge automatically when Homebridge starts.

pythonPath.title: Python Path
pythonPath.description: Path to Python 3.12. For best results use the absolute path to the plugin venv Python executable.

dataDir.title: Bridge Data Directory
dataDir.description: Optional. Defaults to Homebridge storage path plus hon-wine-cooler. Stores the pyhOn refresh token and cached state.
